description: This Java source file defines a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS, demonstrating complication integration, drawing routines, and time updates for a wearable device.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService that manages the lifecycle of the watch face.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class that handles drawing, updates, and complication data management for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face, sets style, loads resources, and configures complications.

methods.name: initializeBackground
methods.description: Prepares the background paint and loads the background image.

methods.name: initializeComplication
methods.description: Sets up complication data structures and configurations.

methods.name: initializeWatchFace
methods.description: Sets default color styles, initializes paint objects, and extracts style colors from background.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the main drawing routine for the watch face, rendering background, complications, and watch hands.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Draws the background image or solid color based on ambient mode.

methods.name: drawComplications
methods.description: Renders the complication texts and handles tap detection.

methods.name: drawWatchFace
methods.description: Draws clock hands, tick marks, and other watch face details.
